entities.summary: Inácio Saure, I.M.C. is a Mozambican prelate of the Catholic Church who has been Archbishop of Nampula since 2017. He was the Bishop of Tete from 2011 to 2017 and is a member of the Consolata Missionaries. Inácio Saure was a religious figures from Balama (b. 1960-03-02, Balama). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
